voices.note: ת"ר (75a.5): one who traps a chilazon and cracks it is liable only one
whose concession in pesik reisha Abaye and Rava report
anonymous redactorial voice of this sugya

props.gloss_en: the baraita: one who traps a chilazon and cracks it is liable only one [sin-offering]
R' Yochanan: [the baraita speaks of] where he cracked it dead
Rava: even if you say he cracked it alive, he is mitasek (acting without intent) with respect to taking a life
Abaye and Rava: R' Shimon concedes in [a case of] 'cut off its head and will it not die?' -- [one is liable]
here it is different: the longer it has life in it the better it suits him, so that its dye will be clear

objections.gloss_en: וליחייב נמי משום נטילת נשמה -- let him be liable also for taking a life [so more than one]

answered_by.gloss_en: שפצעו מת -- he cracked it when it was already dead (= p_ryochanan_potzeo_met)
אפילו תימא שפצעו חי, מתעסק הוא אצל נטילת נשמה (= p_rava_mitasek)

objections.gloss_en: והא אביי ורבא דאמרי תרוייהו: מודה רבי שמעון בפסיק רישיה ולא ימות -- cracking a live chilazon inevitably kills it, so how can he be mitasek?

answered_by.gloss_en: שאני הכא -- the longer it lives the better for him, so that its dye will be clear (= p_shani_hacha_chilazon)
